prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A mid-shot of a man in his early thirties, with short dark hair and a trimmed beard, stands in the foreground, writing on a transparent glass board with a black marker. He wears a teal-blue button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up, exuding a casual yet professional demeanor. His expression is focused and intent, eyes following the movement of his hand as he writes the word "Analysis" in large, clear letters. Behind the glass, two colleagues—one with long curly hair in a striped blazer, the other with short dark hair—are slightly out of focus, suggesting depth of field and drawing attention to the main subject. The background features large windows with horizontal blinds, letting in diffused natural daylight that casts a cool, bluish tone across the scene. The overall color palette is dominated by cool blues and soft grays, creating a modern, analytical atmosphere. The composition is cinematic, with a shallow depth of field and a slight over-the-shoulder perspective, immersing the viewer in a dynamic, collaborative office environment.
